Pulseq MATLAB toolbox: the +mr package of the matlab/ folder of pulseq-master (file format v1.4), copied unchanged on 2026-11-23 from the local copy used to write the scanned .seq files. Demo and example folders are not included.
Source: https://github.com/pulseq/pulseq. License: MIT (see LICENSE in this folder); authors in AUTHORS.
Used by sequence/*.m and by code/supporting_analyses/rev_readout_fov.m to compute the k-space trajectory of sequence/*.seq.
